patthana17.14:1.1: akusalaṃ micchattaniyataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na akusalo na micchattaniyato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana17.14:2.1: kusalaṃ sammattaniyataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na kusalo na sammattaniyato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana17.14:3.1: abyākataṃ aniyataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na abyākato na aniyato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā pañca.
